name: Stefanie Hagger
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Stress Therapy Australia currently provides therapeutic services for children, adolescents, and adults throughout Boroondara and Yarra Ranges. Specialty areas include anxiety/coping strategies, grief and loss, complex trauma, anger management, burn out, and depression.

name: Eryka Rhodes
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: With more than 20 years of listening to people’s stories, I work with you to create the next chapter. I’m a qualified and registered Counsellor, based in the Mornington Peninsula, who skilfully supports adolescents, adults and relationships. I’ll help you navigate the path to find your purpose, reframe concerns and look forward to an improved relationship with yourself and others.

name: Beata Sabala
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a clinical counsellor and somatic psychotherapist with special interest in supporting persons who navigate through trauma recovery whether it is complex (developmental) trauma or a single incident trauma. My work is informed by attachment, trauma and Polyvagal theories and can be somatically oriented. I offer EMDR and Somatic Experiencing (SE Practitioner), in which I am fully trained. I also draw upon mindfulness-based approaches, Schema Therapy, Existential Therapy, and Emotion-Focused Therapy.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Marcus Backman
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Marcus is a person-centred psychotherapist who specialises in using Emotion Focused Therapy to create a safe, affirming and compassionate therapeutic space that supports his clients on their growth and healing journeys. His experience covers working with a diverse range of people in an empathic, warm, non-judgemental, affirming, safe, and trauma-informed way. He strives to be accepting in his practice, particularly in relation to all aspects of identity including cultural identity, neurodiversity, gender, disability, age, and sexuality.

name: Kerryn Knight
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Kerryn Knight, founder of Empowered Art Therapy, Kindred Art Space, Art Therapist, Clinical Counsellor, and Supervisor empowers you to gain clarity and make positive changes in a creative and culturally appropriate manner through specialist creative inquiry; counseling and psychotherapeutic processes. Kerryn's creative approach empowers you to gain a different perspective on issues to make meaning and find solutions. The emphasis is on the process and not an artistic outcome.

name: Jaana Sahling
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
address: Abbotsford Convent 1 St Heliers Street. Abbotsford Vic 3067
description: I’m a passionate creative art therapist, dedicated to sharing the transformative power of the creative process with individuals of all ages, backgrounds, genders, and abilities. Additionally, I practice trauma-informed care, which means I am sensitive to the impact of trauma and prioritize creating a safe, supportive environment. This approach acknowledges the widespread nature of trauma and its effects, ensuring that our work together is respectful and empowering, avoiding any potential re-traumatization.

name: tahli rockman
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Emma Gilmour
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I work with adults primarily around alcohol, food and body image concerns. I am an Autistic ADHD therapist with lived experience of all of the above. My practice is Neuro & LGBTQI+ affirming and trauma informed.
